correctness.rationale: With f=1_[0,ℓ]+1_[ℓ+g,2ℓ+g], Plancherel turns squared Fourier intensity distance into autocorrelation tent translation distance. Positive and negative lag supports are disjoint for g,h>0; direct triangle self-overlap gives Dℓ(δ)=4ℓδ²−2δ³ (δ≤ℓ), 8ℓ³/3−2(2ℓ−δ)³/3 (ℓ≤δ≤2ℓ), then plateau 8ℓ³/3. Hilbert ball intersection gives the exact critical ε=√(2ℓ³/3). The L² Fréchet width/gap derivative exists because corner errors are O(|Δ|^{3/2}); its Gram entries are 16ℓ, 4ℓ and 4min(ℓ,g), with positive determinant. Independently integrated five covariogram difference instances across all regimes and recomputed the Gram algebra. This supports the exact claimed normalization, not general noisy reconstruction.
